findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The class was changed to subclass StatefulDetectorHandler with a body of `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler declares several abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data), none of which are implemented here. Instantiating it raises TypeError. Since MetricAlertFire.detector_handler points at this class, any detector of type metric_alert_fire will now crash in Detector.detector_handler / process_detectors instead of returning no results as the previous stub did.

findings.title: New abstract hook breaks all existing StatefulDetectorHandler subclasses
findings.body: build_occurrence_and_event_data is added as @abc.abstractmethod on StatefulDetectorHandler. Any existing or downstream subclass that does not implement it becomes uninstantiable, with no default or migration path. Consider a default implementation that raises NotImplementedError only when a result is actually needed, or clearly document the required override.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring of StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate says it 'returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult', but the signature and implementation now return a dict keyed by group key. This misleads implementers of the new contract.

findings.title: test_dedupe expects an occurrence fingerprinted for a different group key
findings.body: In TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe, the expected occurrence is built with build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, 'val1', ...), so its fingerprint is '<id>:val1'. The call under test is evaluate_group_key_value('group_key', 10, ...), which builds its occurrence with fingerprint '<id>:group_key'. The DetectorEvaluationResult equality check should therefore fail, meaning this test is broken as written. The expected occurrence should use the same group key ('group_key') as the call.
